name: Baked Popcorn-Style Shrimp with Homemade Cocktail Sauce

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper and set aside.

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and spices in a medium bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place breadcrumbs in a large bowl.
Add shrimp to the bowl with the seasoned mayo and toss to coat.

Working in batches, add shrimp to the bowl with the bread crumbs and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Divide shrimp between prepared baking sheets, arranging in a single layer. Drizzle with oil.
Place shrimp in the oven and bake for 8 minutes, then flip and continue to bake until golden and crisp, 5-6 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add ketchup, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices. Stir to combine the cocktail sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
⅔ cup ketchup
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp chili powder
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Arrange shrimp on a platter and serve with cocktail sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
